knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A cleaning checklist records cleaning work. Verification, monitoring and release are separate records and decisions, so the checklist alone does not show absence of micro-organisms.
An unseen step is marked not verified, with the reason. Ticking it or removing it hides a gap in the record.
A premature restart request is refused, recorded and escalated. Signing with a note still records a false readiness.

practicalCriteria: Classifies each line of a fictional sign-off checklist as cleaning, verification, monitoring or release, and states the classification.
Marks at least one unseen step as not verified, gives the reason, and names a person to verify it.
Notes which part of a large item was observed and which was not reached, without changing a colleague's entry.
Refuses a simulated premature restart request, records the requester, time and pending items, and escalates to the mock authorised person.
Uses no sterility, pathogen-free or allergen-free wording in the completed record.
passRule: All five practical criteria observed as met in an inert tabletop simulation. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass, and no part of this assessment confers release or sanitation clearance.
evidenceRequired: Refusal and escalation record for the simulated restart request
Assessor observation note for each practical criterion
stopWorkCriteria: Restart signed before the simulated results or release decision are recorded
Unseen step ticked or carried forward
Repeat testing performed without recording the earlier result
Record describes the line as sterile, pathogen-free or allergen-free
